sentences.text: 4. The counsel for the State and the objector have opposed the application and submitted that offence of rape has been committed against minor.
Thus, looking to the gravity of offence, no case for grant of bail to the applicant is made out.
5. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

6 . On perusal of the record, it reflects that prosecutrix and applicant are known to each other since last eight years and on her own volition, the prosectrix went the applicant's house and Vidisha and Agra as well.

7. Thus, considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicant who is aged about 22 years, is in custody since 07/09/2024 and his past record is unblemished, thus this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

8. It is directed that the applicant - Dinesh Rawat @ Dinu shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60668 3 MCRC-49151-2024 Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
9. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
